author: Museo Antropológico Padre Sebastian Englert (MAPSE)
title: Museo Antropológico Padre Sebastian Englert (MAPSE) collection record for Moai kavakava, Rapa Nui — 17-296

claims.value: This piece named Moai Mana‘u was carved by the artist Tomás Tuki Tepano, as part of his personal collection. This artist always carves a copy of his pieces to conserve one in his personal collection. He agreed to sell it to the museum because he was interested in keeping his work for the future. This piece won the seal of excellence for ‘Chilean handicrafts’ in 2012. It also received the UNESCO Artesanías del Mercosur recognition in 2012.
